title: System Overview: Structures
description: The system inspector now shows each planet's PDS and space docks inside its planet card: icon in the owner's colour, seat badge, name (II card when researched), count, and the production value or space cannon number from the game content. They no longer appear a second time in the unit list. Also: the icon gallery of three candidates per structure; option (a) of each was chosen. Before shots are taken on the base commit and committed; npm run screenshots -- BA regenerates the after shots. Synthetic fixtures, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Before: structures only as chips in the unit list
shots.caption: Jord's PDS and Space Dock sit among the infantry under 'On Jord'; the planet cards show nothing about them.

shots.heading: After: structures inside the planet card
shots.caption: Jord shows its PDS (space cannon) and Space Dock (production); Exhausted World shows its PDS. The unit list keeps only ground forces.

shots.heading: Before (390 px)
shots.caption: Same as above on a phone.

shots.heading: After (390 px)
shots.caption: Rows wrap inside the card; text is 12 px or larger.

shots.heading: Before: an opponent's PDS
shots.caption: The opponent's PDS and infantry share one chip row.

shots.heading: After: an opponent's PDS
shots.caption: The opponent's PDS shows with their colour bar and seat badge in the planet card; their infantry stays in the unit list.

shots.heading: Icon candidates
shots.caption: Three candidates each for PDS and Space Dock at 16, 20 and 28 px, in three owner colours, on dark and light backgrounds. Chosen: PDS (a) turret on a base, Space Dock (a) ring station with docking arms.

notes.title: Reproduce.
notes.text: Before shots: TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before npm run screenshots -- BA on the base commit, then moved into before/ and committed.
